data.title: 长离 · 边庭的沙盘推演
data.description: 今州边庭，她俯身在巨大的沙盘/棋盘前移动棋子，指尖悬停在最后一手之上；抬眼微笑的瞬间，对手的命运已在局中——军师的日常即是布局。
data.action: 今州边庭，她俯身在巨大的沙盘/棋盘前移动棋子，指尖悬停在最后一手之上
data.promptProse: Changli leans over the large strategy board in Jinzhou's side courtyard, one hand moving a piece and fingertips lingering above the final move. Her layered white-and-red robe and high-collared inner blouse remain clear as she lifts her eyes with a measured smile. The medium view includes the board grid in front and courtyard wall behind. Afternoon light highlights embroidered cuffs and piece tops, with distinct small shadows explaining their arrangement.
